name: @pieai/university-local
description: UniversityLocal — the authoring server. Courses are written by the CLI and read off the disk; the browser that shows them is apps/university.

scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json university-local.config.json university-local.config.local.example.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.server.json tsconfig.server.build.json vitest.config.ts server scripts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json university-local.config.json university-local.config.local.example.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.server.json tsconfig.server.build.json vitest.config.ts server scripts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm lint:lessons && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:export-freshness && pnpm docs:check
scripts.docs:check: pnpm pro-gov doctor && pnpm doc-gov router-check && pnpm doc-gov check && pnpm doc-gov scan --check && pnpm doc-gov links && pnpm doc-gov audit && pnpm doc-gov doctor
